name: team-harness
description: Run the complete shared Team Harness skill catalog in Codex with native setup, updates, hooks, and gated workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Shared workflows, diagrams, GCP, and delivery.
interface.longDescription: Use the complete shared Team Harness skill catalog in Codex through native runtime adapters, including diagrams, GCP, research, review, setup, updates, lightweight intake, and the explicitly gated delivery pipeline.
defaultPrompt: @Team-Harness modes: list the available Team Harness skills and explain when to use each one.
@Team-Harness setup: configure Team Harness for Codex.
@Team-Harness update: update the Codex marketplace, plugin, configuration, and installed agents.
@Team-Harness init: help me frame or handle this task without starting the full pipeline.
@Team-Harness pipeline: explicitly start the full gated workflow for this change in the current Main thread.
Use Team Harness to create an architecture diagram for this repository.
Use Team Harness to inspect GCP infrastructure in read-only plan mode.
Continue implementation of the active approved Team Harness pipeline.
Recover the active Team Harness workspace.
